fixed.explanation: In parseRawCookie, Expires and Max-Age both overwrite cookie.expires in order of appearance, so a later past Expires overrides an earlier Max-Age. Also parseInt accepts lenient values like "10abc". Fix: track Max-Age separately, apply it after the loop, and require a strict integer regex.

query.intent: Cookie parsing and expiry computation for APIRequestContext (Set-Cookie handling): when both Max-Age and Expires attributes are present, Max-Age must take precedence regardless of order; a non-integer Max-Age value must be ignored rather than parsed leniently.
query.symptom: A cookie is dropped when Max-Age appears before a past Expires in Set-Cookie, and non-integer Max-Age values are not ignored.
